jei.sagittary.fletching_table.title: Fletching Table
jei.sagittary.component.flint_tip.desc: Standard arrow tip. No special effects.
jei.sagittary.component.amethyst_tip.des: Applies Slowness effect on hit. Creates purple particle trail.
jei.sagittary.component.copper_tip.desc: 10% chance to summon lightning on hit.
jei.sagittary.component.slime_tip.desc: Arrow bounces off blocks AND entities up to 4 times.
jei.sagittary.component.glowstone_tip.de: Applies Glowing effect on hit (like Spectral Arrows). Glowstone+Stick+Feather in fletching table makes Spectral Arrows.
jei.sagittary.component.echo_shard_tip.d: Sonic boom arrow. Creates AOE damage burst on impact (entity or block).
Teleports entities on hit. Hitting a block teleports the shooter.
jei.sagittary.component.iron_tip.desc: Heavy arrow with 40% more gravity. Armor piercing - 30% of damage bypasses armor.
jei.sagittary.component.diamond_tip.desc: Piercing arrow - passes through up to 4 entities with reduced damage per pierce.
jei.sagittary.component.ruby_tip.desc: Creates a small, non-destructive burst of fire around the target.
jei.sagittary.component.sapphire_tip.des: Freezes and slows nearby enemies on impact.
jei.sagittary.component.topaz_tip.desc: Reveals up to 12 nearby prospector targets with a brief gold outline.
jei.sagittary.component.bronze_tip.desc: Creates a small non-destructive knockback pulse.
jei.sagittary.component.electrum_tip.des: Chains reduced damage to up to two nearby enemies.
jei.sagittary.component.invar_tip.desc: A heavy, high-gravity arrow with armor-piercing bonus damage.
jei.sagittary.component.breeze_rod_shaft: Lightweight homing arrow. 40% less gravity, 25% faster, seeks nearest enemy, strong knockback.
jei.sagittary.component.bone_shaft.desc: Smite effect - deals 2.5x damage to undead mobs.
Faster but destroyed on ground hit.
jei.sagittary.component_arrow.title: Component Arrow
jei.sagittary.quiver.desc: Stores 64 arrows across up to 5 arrow types. Bows automatically use arrows from quivers. Hold V and scroll to select an arrow type.
jei.sagittary.iron_bow.desc: A more durable bow made of iron. 1.5x durability and slightly increased range.
jei.sagittary.iron_crossbow.desc: A more durable crossbow made of iron. 1.5x durability and increased range.
jei.sagittary.compound_bow.desc: Shoots 3 arrows in a spread pattern. Consumes 3 arrows per shot. Found in Trial Chamber reward chests.
jei.sagittary.repeater_crossbow.desc: A magazine-fed rapid-fire crossbow. Load 5 arrows, then fire 3 per shot. Found in Ancient City chests.
